findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/regions.js:regionsReadBaseAllowlist::the base allowlist is trusted without the shape validation the head-side list gets
findings.title: the base allowlist is trusted without the shape validation the head-side list gets
findings.action: guard an allowlist path outside the repository; keep base entries membership-only
findings.disposition_rationale: Base entries are used only for membership against a fully validated head list, so a malformed base entry cannot admit any head entry; validating the base strictly would block the PR that fixes a malformed base. The realpath concern is guarded: an allowlist resolving outside the repository now throws (exit 2), and a wrong in-repo path falls back to the base-tree set, which is no weaker (001fe857).

occurrences.title: the base allowlist is trusted without the shape validation the head-side list gets
